title: Maltın Peşinde
author: Burkay Adalığ
description: Part travelogue, part guidebook, this volume captures the landscapes, people, and spirit of Scotland while also presenting the most comprehensive directory of its whisky distilleries. Organized region by region, it combines practical travel tips with in-depth whisky expertise, inviting readers to embark on their own malt journeys.
english_title: In Pursuit of Malt: Scotland’s Whisky Distilleries
